name: epistemic-factory
description: Gated Build Factory: standalone Epistemic Quote & Cache Verifier MCP server plus single-worktree gated build state machine & CLI.

scripts.check: bun test --pass-with-no-tests && bun run typecheck && biome check .
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/epistemic-verifier-mcp && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/epistemic-verifier-mcp/tsconfig.build.json packages/core/tsconfig.build.json packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/fix-dist-bins.mjs packages/epistemic-verifier-mcp/dist/mcp-server.js packages/cli/dist/bin.js
scripts.accept: bash scripts/accept/wave-1.sh && bash scripts/accept/wave-2.sh && bash scripts/accept/wave-3.sh
